# Security policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Security fixes |
|---|---|
| 1.x (latest release) | Supported |
| Older versions | Update to the latest 1.x release |

## Report privately

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/CodeNKoffee/acl9-winter26-team13/security/advisories/new). If that route is unavailable, email maintainer **hatemthedev@gmail.com** with the subject `ACL9 Apex security report`. Do not open a public issue with exploit details or secrets. Include affected files, reproduction steps, and impact; use synthetic data.

## Scope

This repository's static website, scripts, security headers, and dependency configuration are in scope. The website has no login, database, or prediction API. Google Drive, GitHub, Vercel, and other third-party services are managed by their own providers. The existing ZIP is owner-managed coursework; report concerns privately, but do not assume the website license or security validation covers its contents.

The maintainer will review reports and coordinate a fix or mitigation. No response-time guarantee is made.
